d:
The Knicks defeated the Bucks, 117-85 tonight in New York. Jalen Brunson contributed a team-high 23 points to go with 4 rebounds and 2 assists, with Karl-Anthony Towns of the Knicks adding an additional 21 points (5-14 FG, 2-9 3P) in the game. Jaime Jaquez Jr. finished with a team-high 16 points along with 5 rebounds for the Bucks in the losing effort. The Knicks improve their record to 6-4 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-10 for the season.
